fusion_variants.mean: Equal mean over every available registered crop response.
fusion_variants.gaussian: nnU-Net-style separable Gaussian importance weighting with sigma_scale=1/8 and maximum weight normalized to one.
fusion_variants.hann: Outer product of two exact length-32 symmetric Hann windows; cells whose available weights all equal zero fall back to their equal mean.
fusion_variants.hard_center: Average the tied observations having maximum crop-local Chebyshev distance from the crop boundary.
fusion_variants.context_bias_weighted_mean: Frozen PCAF: crop-coordinate median subtraction followed by inverse robust-variance weighting.

preregistration.parameter_selection: No target normal, defect score, mask, or metric selects a window, scale, fallback, or reported fold.
preregistration.primary_comparison: Seven-roll macro Pixel AP of PCAF minus each deterministic geometry-only fusion under the identical 73-crop observation budget.
preregistration.support_condition: PCAF must exceed the strongest deterministic baseline in seven-roll macro Pixel AP. Fold wins, exact sign tests, instance AUC, source-calibrated target-normal false positives, and all losing folds remain diagnostic and are reported without tuning.
preregistration.failure_condition: If a deterministic baseline equals or exceeds PCAF in macro Pixel AP, do not claim that learned coordinate calibration is superior to fixed center weighting.

geometric_fusion.hard_center_tie_rule: equal mean among observations tied for maximum boundary distance

context_response_calibration.score: pattern-conditional empirical upper-tail of one-sided robust residual energy
context_response_calibration.physical_field_estimator: inverse-robust-variance weighted mean after crop-relative median bias removal

ablation_estimators.context_bias_equal_mean: equal mean after crop-relative median bias removal
ablation_estimators.context_scale_weighted_mean: inverse-robust-variance weighted raw response without bias removal
